title: Do you actually need AI to predict the market, or just to run your checklist?
author: Intelligent_Ad2105
selftext:
most AI trading marketing is about predictions, price targets, and the next hot token. But if you already have a strategy that works, the bottleneck usually isn't another forecast. It's the repetitive work: watching conditions, handling entries and exits, running the same research across multiple markets every day.

that part is where automation seems more useful than another opinion on where BTC is heading. platforms like alphio approach it that way, turning a research idea or a plain-language instruction into a task that keeps running under rules and limits you set, instead of promising to call the market. so a question for anyone running their own process: if you could hand AI exactly one job, would it be researching markets, hunting for new setups, or executing the strategy you already trust?
